scope: Tracked reproduction of checker-tool controls; no whole-port qualification or compiler performance win

inventory.Cxx_compilations: one per suite, no compilation per case

provenance.Cpp_fixtures: Exact copies of the already-qualified probe, inherited laws and source-extracted visited fixture; original paths/hashes and extraction manifest retained in fixtures.json
provenance.semantic_fixtures: Existing generated Goose/C literal values checked byte-exact; upstream cases referenced by verified path/hash rather than copied
provenance.visited_binding: Runner refuses changed current AST, TypeEq, TypeArgsEq, SameIndex, LoadType, visited context or ordered array walk

packaging_validation.cap_note: Relocated smoke took27.073s under the original30s cap; packaged runner uses120s to tolerate host load without altering fixture scale or assertions.
packaging_validation.semantic_runner_whitespace: Blank source lines normalized with identical Python AST and decoded fixture bytes.

micro_tradeoff.scope: Actual AST/gate synthetic workloads only, fixture construction excluded; not whole compiler timing
micro_tradeoff.interpretation: Additional cached pointer entries/allocations regress cold roots; reuse order controls amortization. Optional experiment, no universal performance claim.

limits: Stability probe uses actual AST/gates but models query leaves; larger cached-member audit uses other proved members as assumptions
Visited probe contains exact extracted equality/traversal code with controlled lazy-instantiation and array-size leaves
Host allocation/OOM schedules and whole current compiler/runtime remain unqualified
